name: betterstack-mcp
description: Every Better Stack Uptime feature, plus an offline SQLite mirror and cross-resource fleet analytics — what's down and who's paged, coverage gaps, MTTA/MTTR, flapping, on-call gaps, and status-page drift — that the API alone can't answer.

betterstack_api_token.title: Better Stack API token
betterstack_api_token.description: Your Better Stack Uptime API token (Better Stack > Settings > API tokens). Sent only to the Better Stack API host as Authorization: Bearer.

betterstack_base_url.title: Better Stack API base URL
betterstack_base_url.description: Base URL for the Better Stack API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

betterstack_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
betterstack_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

betterstack_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
betterstack_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API instead of the local store. Leave blank to keep the local store.

betterstack_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
betterstack_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Better Stack requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

betterstack_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
betterstack_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
